storyline.real: A tyre warning puts Hamilton on three stops in a light McLaren. He passes Massa for the lead on lap 24 and is 14.4 s clear of him on lap 43, but after his last stop on lap 45 he rejoins behind him. Massa wins by 3.8 s, his third Istanbul win in a row, with Räikkönen half a second behind Hamilton.
storyline.headline: Hamilton's three stops beat Massa in Istanbul

mastery.label: Finish second or better on three stops

hidden.label: Finish second or better pushing for no more than 30 laps

eras.briefing: Istanbul, 2008. Massa takes pole for Ferrari, Hamilton qualifies third. Bridgestone fears for Hamilton's front-right tyre, so McLaren run him light on three stops. You run Hamilton, second and 1.2 s behind Massa after 13 laps. Finish second at least, and beat Massa's two-stop Ferrari if you can.
